summary: This bill reauthorizes the State Offices of Rural Health Program by specifying the amount of funding authorized for grants for fiscal years 2023 through 2032.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes and increases funding for State Offices of Rural Health, which are programs designed to improve healthcare access and quality in rural areas. This directly supports public health infrastructure and access, aligning with more public healthcare.

The bill directly authorizes $12.5M–$13.5M in annual federal appropriations for the State offices of rural health program, increasing authorized spending without offsets and thereby accepting a larger deficit to fund this priority.

The entire bill reauthorizes and funds a federal grant program for state rural health offices, constituting direct government action to support healthcare access and infrastructure in underserved areas.
